identity.title: Gas density drops inside dust cavities of transitional disks around young stars observed with ALMA

paper_type_evidence.quote: We use Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) observations of $^{12}$CO 6–5 and 690 GHz (Band 9) continuum of five well-studied transitional disks.

question.value: How much the gas surface density (delta_gas) and dust density drop inside the dust cavities of transitional disks, and what this implies for clearing by companions and dust trapping

evidence.quote: The observations are used to set constraints on the gas and dust surface density profiles, in particular the drop $\delta_{\rm gas}$ of the gas density inside the dust cavity.
Five transitional disks were observed in ALMA program 2011.0.00724.S (PI Pérez)
Disk J1604-2130 was observed as part of ALMA program 2011.0.00526.S (PI Carpenter), in Band 7

bands.value: Band 9 (690 GHz, 440 μm) for five disks; Band 7 (345 GHz) for J1604-2130

evidence.quote: The disks were observed in Band 9 (690 GHz, 440 $\mu$m)

frequencies_and_spectral_setup.value: Four 1875 MHz spectral windows, 3840 channels of 488 kHz (0.2 km/s); one centered on 12CO 6-5

evidence.quote: with four adjacent spectral windows of 1875 MHz, each with 3840 channels of 488 kHz (0.2 km s$^{-1}$) width
One spectral window was centered on the $^{12}$CO 6–5 line (691.47308 GHz).
one spectral window centered on the $^{12}$CO 3–2 line (345.79599 GHz)
for a total continuum bandwidth of 7.5 GHz
with baselines ranging from 20 to 500 m, probing scales from 0.2 to 4 arcseconds
could not be recovered by the shortest baselines of these ALMA observations (50 k$\lambda$, or 4” scales)
Each target was observed for $\sim$25 minutes on source.
obtained during ALMA Cycle 0 between June 2012 and January 2013

pi_or_archival_as_stated.value: Programs of PI Pérez and PI Carpenter; J1604 data previously published by Zhang et al. 2014

evidence.quote: The data and observational details are presented in (cite: Zhang2014).

other_facilities.name: Spitzer (IRS, IRAC, MIPS), WISE, SED photometry

provided.value: SED photometry used to constrain dust model

evidence.quote: the Spitzer IRS and WISE photometry (taken in 2007 and 2012, respectively) do reveal the excess

what.value: Stellar parameters (L*, M*, R*, Teff, accretion rate, d, A_V)

evidence.quote: Stellar parameters taken from the literature are given in Table [\[tbl:stellar\]](#tbl:stellar).

external_data_from_literature.citation: Table 1 refs (cite: Dunkin1997; Pontoppidan2008; Andrews2011; etc.)

what.value: 345 GHz SMA cavity radii and visibility nulls

evidence.quote: Location of the null in the visibilities of models and SMA observations at various frequencies (cite: Andrews2011).
The bandpass was calibrated using 3C279, Titan was used as flux calibrator

self_calibration.value: Amplitude and phase self-calibration on all data, applied to CO

evidence.quote: amplitude and phase self-calibration were performed on all data and applied afterwards to the $^{12}$CO data as well.
The data were imaged using CASA v4.2, adopting the Briggs weighting scheme with robust of 0.5.
adopting the Briggs weighting scheme with robust of 0.5

what.value: Physical disk structure and dust opacities (small/large populations, f_ls, chi)

evidence.quote: As a starting point for our models we adopt the physical structure suggested by (cite: Andrews2011), as implemented by (cite: Bruderer2013)
similar to the approach in (cite: Bruderer2014)
The data and observational details are presented in (cite: Zhang2014).

unstated_but_needed: Imaging cell size, image size, masking, deconvolver and clean threshold
Continuum subtraction method and line-free channels
DALI model input files and exact best-fit parameter grids
Dust opacity table details, including the modified SR21 table

analysis_steps.goal: Image continuum and CO, derive geometry

method.value: Clean images; stellar position, inclination, PA and v_src from channel and first-moment maps with Keplerian overlay

evidence.quote: We derive the stellar position, inclination, position angle and source velocity from the channel maps and first moment map
For the stellar mass, we use values from the literature
The derived parameters are consistent within 5$^{\circ}$ with values from the literature

analysis_steps.goal: Fit dust structure to SED and continuum visibilities

method.value: DALI model manually tuned to SED, visibility amplitude and image cuts; vary delta_dustcav 1e-2 to 1e-6

evidence.quote: the $\delta_{\rm dustcav}$ value (drop of dust density inside the cavity) is varied with values between 10$^{-2}$ and 10$^{-6}$

key_parameters.value: gamma = 1, GDR = 100, turbulent width 0.2 km/s, PAH 0.1%

evidence.quote: The turbulent width is set to 0.2 km s$^{-1}$.
thus any azimuthal asymmetries are ignored

fitting.value: Manual fitting by eye, no chi2 or MCMC

evidence.quote: We do not use a $\chi^2$ or Markov-Chain-Monte-Carlo (MCMC) method, as the computational time of the models is too long

validation.value: Comparison with SED, visibility null, image cuts

evidence.quote: Reasonable fits are found for the continuum visibilities and SED within the constraints of our physical model for all targets.

method.value: Vary delta_gas from 1e0 to 1e-4 in steps of 10 holding other parameters fixed; compare spectra, intensity cuts, visibilities

evidence.quote: we present the same physical model with $\delta_{\rm gas}$ varying from 10$^{0}$ to 10$^{-4}$ in steps of 10
There was no need to change the gas to dust ratio of 100 in any of the cases in the outer disk.
In the fitting procedure, we use an approach of manual fitting by eye, varying the parameters in a logical order, converging to a model that fits the data

validation.value: Tested alternative 30 AU gas cavity for HD135344B

evidence.quote: It turns out that there is no significant difference in the outcome for 30 AU or 40 AU gas cavity radius.
The data were imaged using CASA v4.2

used_for.value: Physical-chemical disk modeling of gas and dust

evidence.quote: The physical-chemical modeling code DALI is used to analyze the gas and dust images simultaneously.
A $\delta_{\rm gas}$ of 10$^{-1}-10^{-2}$ is sufficient to fit the peak in the moment map.
We find a cavity size of at most 25 AU, which is significantly smaller than the value of 36 AU previously found
We can constrain the inner density drop to $\delta_{\rm gas2}=10^{-5}$
Therefore, $\delta_{\rm dustcav}$ is constrained to be at most a factor of 10$^{-4}$, and even as low as 10$^{-6}$ for J1604-2130.

findings_qualitative.value: All disks show gas inside the dust cavity; gas drops by 1-2 orders of magnitude while dust drops by at least 3

evidence.quote: All disks show clear evidence for gas inside the dust cavity.

claims.hypothesis: Is gas present inside dust cavities and how does its drop compare to dust?
claims.experiment: DALI modeling of SED, 690 GHz visibilities, and 12CO 6-5 maps
claims.result: Gas drop 1e-1 to 1e-2 versus dust drop <=1e-4
claims.finding: Gas-to-dust drop difference consistent with dust trapping by companions

evidence.quote: The gas surface density drops inside the cavity by at least a factor 10, whereas the dust density drops by at least a factor 1000.

claims.hypothesis: Are dust cavities smaller at 690 GHz than at 345 GHz?
claims.experiment: Compare model visibility nulls with SMA data
claims.finding: Radial variation of dust size consistent with trapping

evidence.quote: all disks have significantly smaller cavity sizes (by 5-10 AU) in the 690 GHz continuum data than those derived by (cite: Andrews2011)

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Photoevaporation and dead-zone trapping disfavoured by large cavities, high accretion and gas drop depth

evidence.quote: The drop is deep enough to rule out the dead zone scenario

limitations_admitted.value: Model not unique; no uncertainties derivable; 12CO optically thick

evidence.quote: deriving uncertainties of model parameters, verifying the uniqueness of the fit, and estimating the correlation between parameters is not possible

referee_caveats_inferred: Degeneracy between gas temperature, small dust and delta_gas
Gas cavity radius assumed equal to dust cavity radius

evidence.quote: This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA/2011.0.00724.S, 2011.0.00526.S and 2011.0.00733.S.

reproducibility.score_reason: Public Cycle 0 data, but manual by-eye fitting with DALI and incomplete imaging details limit reproducibility.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Results depend on manual DALI modeling that is not fully specified.

companion_papers.why: earlier presentation of SR21 and HD135344B data
